parameters.num_stacks_s: <int> Number of stacks in the vehicle's loading area.
parameters.stack_height_l: <int> Maximum number of items each stack can hold.
parameters.num_requests_n: <int> Number of customer requests to be served.
parameters.num_pickup_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the pickup region, including the depot.
parameters.num_delivery_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the delivery region, including the depot.
parameters.coordinate_range: <list[int], length 2> Minimum and maximum coordinate values for vertex locations.
parameters.distance_metric: <str> Method used to compute travel distances between vertices.

pickup_region.depot_index: <int> Index of the depot vertex in the pickup region.
pickup_region.coordinates: <list[dict], length num_pickup_vertices> Location of each vertex in the pickup region, with fields vertex_id (int), x (int), and y (int).
pickup_region.distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_pickup_vertices][num_pickup_vertices]> Travel cost between each pair of vertices in the pickup region.

delivery_region.depot_index: <int> Index of the depot vertex in the delivery region.
delivery_region.coordinates: <list[dict], length num_delivery_vertices> Location of each vertex in the delivery region, with fields vertex_id (int), x (int), and y (int).
delivery_region.distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_delivery_vertices][num_delivery_vertices]> Travel cost between each pair of vertices in the delivery region.

requests: <list[dict], length num_requests_n> Each customer request specifying request_id (int), pickup_vertex (int), delivery_vertex (int), and item_size (int).
